# Counterfactual and boundary tests (generated by scripts/counterfactual.py)

Synthetic telemetry: a recorded oracle episode (`green_stop` / `red_proceed`, seed 0) supplies every non-kinematic column; ego speed, route position, stop-line/officer distances, junction flag and collision count are replaced by the scripted profile. Scorer: pinned v2 (`protocol="v2"`). These test the scorer's logic only; they are not evidence that a controller can produce the trajectory.


## eligibility

Expected: credit 0 by movement gate (spec)

| case | strict | credit | action | latency | safety | e | gate | strict reason |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| park at spawn (0 km/h throughout) | FAIL | 0.0000 | 0.0000 | 1.0000 | 1.0000 | 0.0000 | 0 | stationary ego never engaged the STOP/HOLD scenario |
